ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

3. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. going

4. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

5. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

8. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

9. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

11. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

12. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

14. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)

15. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. run
